paper.title_en: Einstein Probe discovery of the magnetar EP J223759.5+531421
paper.abstract_en: We report the discovery and early outburst evolution of the new Galactic magnetar EP J223759.5+531421, detected by the Einstein Probe Wide-field X-ray Telescope on 2026 June 28. Follow-up observations with Einstein Probe, XMM--Newton, NuSTAR, SVOM, and IXPE revealed coherent X-ray pulsations at P ~ 6s and an average period derivative of Pdot ~ 2.8x10^{-12} s/s. These values imply a nominal polar dipolar magnetic field of B_dip ~ 2.6x10^{14} Gauss and a characteristic age of tau_c ~ 34 kyr, although the structured timing residuals suggest possible torque variability. The rms pulsed fraction is approximately 20-25% below ~7 keV and decreases at higher energies. The broadband spectra require multiple thermal components and a hard power-law tail. Adopting a distance of 3.3 kpc, the 0.5-30 keV luminosity declined from 1.2x10^{35} to 5.7x10^{34} erg/s during the first month, accompanied by a decrease in the inferred thermal-emitting areas. At this distance, the Galactic latitude b=-4.56 deg corresponds to a height of approximately 0.26 kpc below the Galactic plane, which is difficult to reconcile with the nominal characteristic age under a simple midplane-birth scenario even for an extreme proper motion velocity. Short X-ray bursts independently confirm the magnetar nature of the source. No near-infrared or radio counterpart were detected by GTC, Medicina or FAST, respectively, down to K_s>21 mag and S_{1.25 GHz} <2.3 microJy. These observations demonstrate the potential of the Einstein Probe WXT monitoring to uncover previously quiescent Galactic magnetars and follow their outbursts from their earliest observed stages.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文报告的是银河系磁星 EP J223759.5+531421 的发现与时序/能谱观测，属于高能天体物理观测研究，并非脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）或引力波相关理论工作；对黑洞热力学、全息凝聚态、广义相对论基础等核心主题亦无实质贡献，因此与索引主题不相关。
decision.title_zh: 爱因斯坦探针发现磁星 EP J223759.5+531421
decision.abstract_zh: 我们报告了新发现的银河系磁星 EP J223759.5+531421 的发现及其早期爆发演化，该源由爱因斯坦探针宽视场 X 射线望远镜于 2026 年 6 月 28 日探测到。使用爱因斯坦探针、XMM--Newton、NuSTAR、SVOM 和 IXPE 的后续观测揭示了周期约为 P ~ 6s 的相干 X 射线脉冲，以及平均周期导数 Pdot ~ 2.8x10^{-12} s/s。这些值意味着标称极向偶极磁场 B_dip ~ 2.6x10^{14} 高斯和特征年龄 tau_c ~ 34 kyr，尽管结构化的计时残差提示可能存在力矩变化。均方根脉冲分数在约 7 keV 以下约为 20-25%，并在更高能量处下降。宽波段能谱需要多个热成分和一个硬幂律尾巴。采用 3.3 kpc 的距离，0.5-30 keV 光度在第一个月内从 1.2x10^{35} 下降到 5.7x10^{34} erg/s，同时推断的热发射面积减小。在该距离下，银纬 b=-4.56 deg 对应于银道面下方约 0.26 kpc 的高度，这很难与标称特征年龄在简单中平面诞生情景下相协调，即使考虑极端自行速度也是如此。短 X 射线暴独立证实了该源的磁星性质。GTC、Medicina 或 FAST 分别未探测到近红外或射电对应体，下限分别为 K_s>21 mag 和 S_{1.25 GHz} <2.3 microJy。这些观测表明，爱因斯坦探针 WXT 监测具有潜力发现此前处于宁静态的银河系磁星，并从其最早观测阶段跟踪其爆发。
